messages:
Ana: Quick sync — want to lock top priorities for tenant routing / networking in private deploys (VPC & on‑prem). Can we list hard launch acceptance criteria and any absolute no‑gos from field customers? cc @Mike @Sarah

Mike: My proposal: 1) preserved egress IPs for tenant traffic, 2) deterministic L3 routing (no surprise SNAT), 3) documented rollback with <5m tenant outage for failed upgrades. Those feel non‑negotiable for mid‑market customers. :white_check_mark:

Sarah: Agree on egress + rollback. Add: operator UX for customer‑managed NAT/IPAM — customers repeatedly asked for a pluggable IPAM contract. If we don't have that in v1, some customers will block.

Alex: Implementation notes from runtime/installer side: we can support a simple IP mapping file and a reconciliation controller for v1. Sketch:
```
# /etc/redwood/ipam-mappings.yaml
tenants:
  - id: acme-corp
    egress_ip: 203.0.113.45
    routes:
      - prefix: 10.40.0.0/16
        next_hop: 192.168.1.1
```
This keeps operator surface small and avoids embedding heavy IPAM integration initially.

Sarah: That YAML sketch helps. Can we also require a validation step in the installer that refuses to start if egress IP conflict detected? Field asked for a safety check.

Mike: +1 validation. Also recommend two rollout modes: canary (per‑tenant) and bulk. Canary must be supported without changing tenant IPs.

deploy-bot: PR merged: feature/tenant-routing-installer‑validation (#8421) — CI green. https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/8421 :rocket:

Ana: Nice — next steps: I'm going to add a short initiative to the roadmap: "Tenant Routing & Customer IP Contracts (v1)" with acceptance criteria: (A) egress IP preservation, (B) installer preflight validation, (C) operator IP mapping contract + docs, (D) canary rollout support. Owners: Alex (engineering), Sarah (field), Mike (SRE). We'll surface to sales/customer success before QPR. If anyone has objections, flag now.

Mike: No objections from infra side.

Sarah: I'll gather 2 customer asks to include in the PRD.

Alex: Will draft the operator API and a minimal installer change list by EOD Friday.

Ana: Thanks — will slot into roadmap planning board and assign tickets. :calendar:
